subject: Implementation orbit-map & tempo — MAP draft, owners, and contingency lanes
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava@optima.ai>, Liam Cho <liam.cho@optima.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation orbit-map & tempo — MAP draft, owners, and contingency lanes

Hi Ava / Liam —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Per our run-through, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that focuses on a 10-week activation window with explicit milestone owners and two contingency lanes (short-delay and capacity-stretch). Key things to review:

- Milestone tempo: weekly delivery gates with three hard cutovers (data ingestion, model tuning, go/no-go).
- Owners: Redwood will own inference runtime setup + canary routing (Ben). Optima owns data validation and final acceptance testing (Ava / Liam).
- Escape hatches: a) fallback to quantized Llama-variant if training delays persist; b) staggered feature enablement to unblock early production reads.

Attachments: optima_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP with dates), implementation_risks_and_escape_hatches.pdf (short risk register).

Please: 1) confirm the target acceptance date of 2028-07-20 or propose a +/– 1 week window, 2) flag any owner changes directly on the Sheet, and 3) confirm who will be the weekly deployment pulse lead on your side.

Proposed next steps: Ben and I will schedule a 30-min runbook walkthrough on Thursday to call out infra tasks and preflight checks. If you can give Ava or Liam to own the Ops pulse that'd be great.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0192

-----

From: Ava Reynolds <ava@optima.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam Cho <liam.cho@optima.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation orbit-map & tempo — MAP draft, owners, and contingency lanes

Thanks Jordan —

Quick read looks good. Two items from our side:

1) Acceptance date: 2028-07-27 is safer for us given a scheduled compliance audit the week of 7/13. Would you be able to preserve the go/no-go gate but shift the final acceptance one week later?
2) Ops pulse lead: Liam will own the weekly cadence and will be the contact for sign-offs.

I'll annotate the MAP sheet with a couple of clarifying notes (data retention window and anonymization owner). We do have one procurement ask: the SOW references 3 months of profiling credits — can you confirm whether that includes a dedicated throughput run? We may need a short dedicated capacity window to validate tail latency under our expected spikes.

—Ava
Ava Reynolds
Head of Integrations, Optima AI
ava@optima.ai

-----

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava@optima.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Liam Cho <liam.cho@optima.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Implementation orbit-map & tempo — MAP draft, owners, and contingency lanes

Ava — appreciate the heads up. We can shift the acceptance target to 2028-07-27 (no problem). Regarding the dedicated throughput run: Redwood includes a profiling window in the onboarding bundle; however, dedicated capacity for spike validation is an additive item. Two options so you can choose what fits best:

Option A — Included profiling: 48-hour focused profiling run (shared cluster) — good for baseline tail-latency and token cost estimates.
Option B — Dedicated capacity burst: 4-hour dedicated GPU window with synthetic spike tests (recommended if you need production-level tail validation).

If you confirm Option B, I'll loop in our procurement lead to add the line item and set the cost/credits. Also, to make the weekly pulse efficient, Jordan / Marissa and I will put a short runbook doc in the Drive (preflight checklist + rollback steps). I'll draft the canary rollout windows in the MAP as conditional tasks (so the sheet shows both optimistic and conservative paths).

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment referenced: implementation_risks_and_escape_hatches.pdf

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava@optima.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam Cho <liam.cho@optima.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Implementation orbit-map & tempo — MAP draft, owners, and contingency lanes

Looping in a slightly more prescriptive milestone cadence so everyone has clear handoffs. I updated the MAP with dates (Drive link above) and added a short owner checklist for each gate (what needs to be green to proceed). Highlights:

- Data Ingest (Gate 1) — target 2028-05-28 — Optima: data schema validated; Redwood: S3 ingestion pipeline and access.
- Model Tuning (Gate 2) — target 2028-06-18 — Optima: provide gold evaluation set; Redwood: tune quantization profile and latency SLOs.
- Canary & Acceptance (Gate 3) — target 2028-07-27 — Optima: acceptance testing; Redwood: canary routing and monitoring dashboards live.

I've also added an "if-blockers" column with concrete mitigation steps (who to call, escalation path, and decision owners). For the procurement item Ben mentioned, Ava — if you confirm the dedicated burst (Option B), Jordan and I will schedule the procurement and mark the MAP accordingly.

Next actions (pick one):
- Ava/Liam: confirm acceptance date (we've accepted 7/27 pending procurement decision) and Ops pulse lead (Liam confirmed).
- Ava: annotate data ownership cells on the MAP sheet by EOD Friday.
- Jordan/Ben/Marissa: schedule the 30-min runbook walkthrough for Thursday 5/18 — proposed slot 10:00–10:30 PT.

Thanks all — I will follow up with a calendar invite once we lock the slot.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success Operations
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

-----

(End of thread)
